sd.verdict.free: A free server, shared with other computers.
sd.kvmNoFree: Free servers are shared, so they can't run VMs.
sd.usageNone: Live usage is not available for this server right now.
sd.usageStale: These are the last readings we have; fresh ones could not be read.
sd.computersNone: No computer of yours is on this server.
sd.freeNoRenew: A free server has no end date and nothing to renew.
sd.noSub: No subscription is listed for this server.
sd.missing: This server is not in your list right now, so only what the Servers view already knew is shown.
sd.computersUnknown: Your computers are not known yet.
sd.basic: Showing what the Servers list knows. More detail could not be read.
sd.cmd.help: These run on the server itself, one at a time. Each is sent once: if the answer is lost, nothing is sent again by itself.
sd.cmd.none: No commands are offered for this server. They exist only for a dedicated server you rent in full, while the rental is current.
sd.cmd.notReady: The server is not ready for commands right now.
sd.cmd.asksTip: Nothing is sent until you confirm. The confirm says what happens to {{server}} and the computers on it.
sd.cmd.restart.meta: Restarts the server at once. Every computer on it stops and starts again.
sd.cmd.restart.tip: Use it when the server stops answering. Unsaved work in its computers is lost.
sd.cmd.why.held: A command sent earlier may still be running. Check it first.
sd.cmd.why.fields: Fill in the required fields first.
sd.cmd.confirm.title: Run {{command}} on {{server}}?
sd.cmd.confirm.body: {{command}} can stop {{server}}. Every computer on it goes down until the server is back, and whatever is running in them is cut off. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
sd.cmd.confirm.on_one: {{count}} of your computers is on this server.
sd.cmd.confirm.on_other: {{count}} of your computers are on this server.
sd.cmd.confirm.unknown: Which of your computers are on this server is not known yet. Assume all of them go down.
sd.cmd.out.label: Output of {{command}}
sd.cmd.accepted: {{command}} was accepted by {{server}} and runs on its own. Watch the usage above to see the server come back.
sd.cmd.refused.cooldown: {{command}} cannot run again yet. Try again later. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.refused.cooldownIn: {{command}} cannot run again yet. It can be run at most once every {{wait}}, so try again later. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.refused.limit: {{command}} has been run too often for now. Try again later. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.refused.limitIn: {{command}} has been run too often for now. Try again in about {{wait}}. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.refused.notReady: The server is not ready. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.refused.generic: The server did not accept {{command}}. Try again later. Nothing was run.
sd.cmd.notSent: {{command}} was not sent, so nothing was run. Try again once Run is available.
sd.cmd.stale: The page changed while {{command}} was being sent. Check before sending it again.
sd.cmd.held: {{command}} sent to {{server}} may already have run. Check before sending another.
sd.cmd.stillUnknown: Checked again. Nothing here can tell whether {{command}} ran, so it stays held. Look at the usage above, and stop tracking it only if you know it did not run.
sd.cmd.inFlight: {{command}} was not run: a run on {{server}} was still being sent when you pressed. It may have finished since. Look at the usage above to see how {{server}} is, then check before running anything again.
sd.cmd.dismiss.title: Stop tracking {{command}}?
sd.cmd.dismiss.body: {{command}} sent to {{server}} may already have run. Stop tracking only if you know it did not run. If it did, running it again does it twice. Stopping tracking sends nothing.
sd.kindSlice: A slice of a shared host
